after_review.review: Wave 2 benchmark-integrity review of genesis-wave2 at 828ca8e (findings H1, H2, H3, M1, M2, M3, M5, L1, L2, L3); fixed on branch gen2-y; this file regenerated on that branch (environment.git_commit)

what_changed.H1 (product): scheduler.tick records an arbitration only for a real conflict: the subject the re-check took is in the timer's curiosity pool for that pass, as the kind curiosity launches, and budget is left (budget_left > 0, no cap reached). Every arbitration recorded before (14 held-out, 11 development per world) was a cooldown refusal of a subject outside that pool; now 0 in every configuration of both splits
what_changed.H2 (harness): the 'integrated' mechanism of the retention and adversarial families forces only the links' settings and the records they need (integrated.forced); before, the whole configuration (every Wave 1 setting off) was forced inside every case
what_changed.H3 (harness): the draw is decoupled: truth changes keyed by (world, seed, step), research outcomes by (world, seed, step, subject); every configuration meets the same world trajectory. The worlds file (integrated_splits.py) is unchanged; only how the harness draws from it changed
what_changed.L1 (harness): the configuration's settings are applied before the staging
what_changed.L2 (script): the best single link is chosen on development (best_single_link_chosen_on); held-out says which single links tie (best_single_link_on_this_split)
what_changed.M1 (harness): activity counts per configuration (splits.*.activity): what each link did and the steps at which what was investigated or held differs from the baseline's run of the same world and seed
what_changed.M2 (product): salience.order falls back to the priority order unless every candidate has a finite numeric score; not exercised by these worlds (every score finite)

after_review.held_out_rerun_disclosure: held-out was re-run because the harness changed (H2, H3, L1, M1, L2) and the arbitration record changed (H1); the frozen worlds and seeds did not change; nothing was chosen on held-out; no default changed
after_review.check_one_stream_draw: held-out, the one-stream draw (decoupled=False) with L1 and H1 in place, baseline, defaults, alone:recheck and integrated: every per-seed value equals the recorded one (before_review) except arbitrations, 14 -> 0 per integrated run; so L1 and H1 move no knowledge metric and every other change below is the draw's (H3)
